FFmpeg 8.1.2 public headers, unmodified, for native/pyav_decode.c (the STT decode).

Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz
SHA-256 of the tarball: 464beb5e7bf0c311e68b45ae2f04e9cc2af88851abb4082231742a74d97b524c
License: LGPL 2.1 or later (COPYING.LGPLv2.1, copied from the tarball).

The files are the include closure of the headers pyav_decode.c includes (cl /showIncludes), copied byte for byte from the tarball.
libavutil/avconfig.h is generated by FFmpeg's configure and is not in the tarball; it is written here as configure writes it for
x86-64 Windows (AV_HAVE_BIGENDIAN 0, AV_HAVE_FAST_UNALIGNED 1).

The headers match the libraries the code calls: the FFmpeg 8.1.2 DLLs of PyAV 18.1.0 (av.ffmpeg_version_info 8.1.2; libavutil
60.26.102, libavcodec 62.28.102, libavformat 62.12.102, libavfilter 11.14.102), loaded at run time by full path after a SHA-256
check (src/stt/decode.rs). No FFmpeg code is compiled into the worker.
